# Standard Schema (@specd/schema-std)

## Rules

### Canonical Schema Definition
- `@specd/schema-std` SHALL provide root `schema.yaml` declaring:
  1. `name`: schema id (`schema-std`)
  2. `version`: monotonically increasing integer
  3. `artifacts[]`: IDs, scope (`change`|`spec`), optionality, output patterns, `requires`, `hasTasks`, rules, validations, metadata extractions, templates
  4. `workflow[]`: step names, transitions, pre/post hooks

### Artifact DAG Invariants
- Artifacts SHALL form acyclic DAG:
  1. `proposal` — change scope, no prereqs
  2. `specs` — requires `proposal`, spec scope
  3. `verify` — requires `specs`, spec scope
  4. `design` — requires `proposal`+`specs`+`verify`, change scope
  5. `tasks` — requires `specs`+`verify`+`design`, change scope, `hasTasks: true`

### Proposal Artifact
- Instruct problem/scope authoring; require sections: `Motivation`, `Current behaviour`, `Proposed solution`, `Specs affected` (new vs modified), `Impact`, `Technical context`, `Open questions`
- Post-authoring: resolve open questions; register spec IDs + deps in change

### Specs Artifact + Deltas
- New: full files under `specs/` — `Purpose`, `Requirements` (`### Requirement:` + SHALL/MUST), `Constraints`, mandatory `Spec Dependencies`
- Modified: structured deltas under `deltas/` — AST ops `added`|`modified`|`removed`|`renamed`|`no-op`
- Validation: single `Requirements` section w/ ≥1 unique `### Requirement:` block
- Post-authoring: complete coverage for all proposal-declared specs

### Verify Artifact + Deltas
- Scenarios under `### Requirement:` matching spec requirement names/order
- `#### Scenario:` + WHEN/THEN; optional GIVEN
- Modified suites: deltas under `deltas/`
- Validation: every requirement ≥1 scenario
- Post-authoring: requirement↔scenario parity `spec.md`↔`verify.md`

### Design Artifact
- Exhaustive self-contained impl contract; no indirect refs
- Required: `Affected areas`, `New constructs` (compilable type sigs), `Data models & Contracts`, `Approach & Execution flow`, `Error handling & Edge cases`, `Key decisions`, `Trade-offs`, `Spec impact`, `Dependency map`, `Migration / Rollback`, `Testing` (unit/integration/manual), `Open questions`
- Post-authoring: full coverage of requirements+scenarios; resolve open questions

### Tasks Artifact
- Minimal single-responsibility units under `## <n>. <Group name>`
- Checkbox `- [ ] <n>.<m> <description>` + indented file/symbol, approach from `design.md`, requirement ID
- Configure `taskCompletionCheck` + `preHashCleanup` for `- [ ]` tracking
- Post-authoring: every design component/change/test covered by ≥1 task

### Cross-Artifact Validations
- `specs-verify-requirement-parity`: exact equality of requirement labels (`specs`) vs requirement group labels (`verify`) per spec

### Metadata Extraction
- From `specs`: `title`, `description`, `dependsOn`, `rules` (`spec-requirements`), `constraints`, `context`
- From `verify`: structured `scenarios` (name, requirement, given, when, then)

### Lifecycle Steps + Transitions
- Steps: `drafting`, `designing`, `ready`, `implementing`, `verifying`, `done`, `pending-signoff`, `signed-off`, `archiving`
- Transitions: permitted forward routes + mandatory gates; declarative pre/post hooks

### Package Distribution
- ESM package exporting `schema.yaml` + templates; no TypeScript compile step required

## Constraints
- `schema.yaml` MUST NOT contain circular artifact prerequisite chains
- Schema MUST stay backwards-compatible within same major version
